videos.title: 10 Bullets for 1 Bird?! The Emu War (1932) #shorts
videos.description:
The army fired 9,860 bullets and got 986 emus. That's 10 bullets for every bird.

The full story: https://youtu.be/rUER31XYzwY

Sources: Wikipedia "Emu War"; Murray Johnson, Journal of Australian Studies (2006).
The voice is an AI copy of my own voice; the pictures are made with an AI image model, and the music is original.
